protocol.change: Retain the actual selected reasoning token sequence; train and evaluate reasoning under its original prompt. LR1e-6 and one update per batch. This is a revised recipe with multiple changes, not a causal isolation of trace preservation.
protocol.selection: Same four-sample internal plurality, no confidence/correctness filtering. The raw-reasoning control learns from one unfiltered current-model trajectory, including incomplete attempts.
protocol.objective: Full FP32 weights/AdamW state, BF16 autocast, no decay, clip1; summed completion NLL divided by fixed128*batch_size. Standard existing LM head.
protocol.primary: Final reasoning accuracy: on-policy minus frozen-source, plus each versus its common baseline. One exploratory optimization seed; no claim of seed replication or scaling exponents.
protocol.cost: All forward/backward/generated tokens reported. Main pair matched in questions, rollout counts, and updates; actual lengths differ. No paid APIs or external labels.

bootstrap: 5000 paired question resamples, stratified by depth. One optimization seed: intervals do not include training-seed or cohort uncertainty.
scope: Exploratory revised recipe. No test-dependent changes within this protocol. No exponent fitting or seed replication claim.
